verdict.rationale: v0 docs explicitly state one-click deploy to production via Vercel infrastructure ('Go live instantly with one-click deployment to production in seconds', 'Deploy with one click to secure, scalable infrastructure powered by Vercel'), and community evidence corroborates a fast dev-to-deploy cycle with a working MVP live quickly. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the exact one-click publish flow and domain/URL setup, and no first-party screenshot/walkthrough of the single-step publish action.
